scope: Official Windows v1.4.4; no v1.3.0 test, no Human/Bot joint run, no component A/B test
boundedConclusion: Existing evidence cannot reduce adaptation to a small verified signature/offset/framework patch. At least eleven native bindings need re-identification or disambiguation across three components, and a BotAI relative CALL patch has changed original bytes. Preserving old behavior would require function/branch/layout investigation beyond this bounded preparation. Stop under the user stop condition; this is a scope judgment, not proof that v1.4.4 can never be ported.
coverageLimit: Scan includes three native gamedata files, all 42 BotAI Windows patch definitions, four BotState bindings/patches and one Aim binding. It is deliberately not a full compatibility certification of CSS, RayTrace, Randomizer, NadeSystem or all native layouts; stop condition was already reached. BotState/BotBlindWindowsSignature was not found as a UTF16 literal in the shipped DLL and remains tag-source-only evidence; it is not a certified original-package binding. Native signatures come directly from ZIP gamedata and equal tag Windows inputs, although two full gamedata JSON objects differ.
newTransactionValidation: not applicable: stopped before transaction changes or candidate build; no install, failure recovery or rollback claim
